北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京大雾，体感较冷，出行注意保暖和交通安全哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy and chilly. Stay warm and drive safely!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波阵雨，湿度百分百，外出记得带伞，注意防潮！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has showers and 100% humidity. Bring an umbrella and watch for dampness!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨，体感微凉，记得带伞，别淋湿了哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain, feels a bit cool. Don't forget your umbrella!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，风力稍大，虽然不冷，早晚还是加件衣裳吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy with some wind. It's mild, but add a layer in the morning and evening!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阵雨，天气暖和但湿度高，记得带伞，保持干爽！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen has showers, it's warm but humid. Bring an umbrella and stay dry!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州大雾，能见度低，开车注意安全，小心慢行哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is very foggy, visibility low. Drive safely and slowly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，湿度近饱和，小心路滑，保暖防湿哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy and very humid. Watch for slippery roads and stay warm and dry!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度百分百，感觉有点湿冷，多穿点别着凉！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and very humid, feeling damp and cool. Bundle up to avoid a chill!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾，湿度大，能见度不高，注意交通安全和防潮！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy and very humid. Drive carefully, and mind the dampness!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，但体感寒冷，出门记得多加衣物，暖暖和和！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is clear but feels quite cold. Remember to layer up and stay warm!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，湿度高，能见度受影响，出行注意安全哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy and humid. Visibility is affected, so travel safely!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨大雾且极寒，一定要穿戴厚实，小心冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is foggy and extremely cold. Bundle up warmly and avoid frostbite!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳有霾，气温低湿度大，请注意防护，保暖防湿！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has haze, cold and very humid. Protect yourself, stay warm and dry!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，但体感较冷，早晚温差大，注意添衣哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is clear but feels cold. Big temperature difference, so dress warmly!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门小雨，暖和但湿度高，记得带伞，保持愉悦心情！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has light rain, warm but humid. Bring an umbrella and stay cheerful!
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾且风力大，体感较冷，出行注意交通安全与保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy with strong winds, feeling cold. Drive safely and stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾，体感微凉，出门注意能见度，小心慢行！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy and feels cool. Watch visibility when out, drive slowly!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦小雨，风力稍大，虽然暖和，还是带把伞吧！
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu has light rain and some wind. It's warm, but still bring an umbrella!
漳浦.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，湿度大，感觉有些湿冷，注意防潮，别着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and very humid. Watch out for dampness and don't catch a cold!
